title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
At Maersk Supply Service, crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator who values openness, collaboration, and trust, and who wants to make a real impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues.

Who are we?

At MSS, we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team that cares about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll join a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration and respect. We offer:

  • A flexible, energised work environment where ideas are valued.
  • A culture that celebrates diversity and teamwork—“we” comes before “I”.
  • The opportunity to shape the future of our operations and support the growth of new seafarers through our Cadet Programme.

This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection. As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What you’ll do

Your mission is simple yet powerful: attract and engage the best maritime talent while ensuring our offshore colleagues feel valued and supported .

You’ll lead initiatives that go beyond filling positions—creating meaningful connections and building trust with candidates and stakeholders. From crafting employer branding to managing end-to-end recruitment, you’ll ensure every interaction reflects our values.

Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Drive talent attraction strategies aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of skilled professionals for offshore roles.
  • Lead the Cadet Programme, supporting the next generation of seafarers.
  • Act as a trusted partner to hiring managers, providing insights and guidance.
  • Champion diversity and inclusion in all recruitment activities and find the candidate with the cultural fit to the company.
  • Continuously improve processes to enhance candidate experience and efficiency.
  • Coordinate offshore recruitment, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, Petrobras).
  • Plan and conduct recruitment for key maritime positions: Captain, Chief Officer, Deck Officer, Chief Engineer, 2nd Engineer Officer, Electrician/ETO, Able Seafarers and Motormen, Cooks and Stewards, etc.
  • Monitor KPIs, report results, and propose improvements.
  • Ensure that candidate records, certifications, and technical documentation are updated and accurate.
  • Support audits and collaborate with Payroll, Training & Compliance, and Vessel Operations.
  • Manage onboarding/offboarding and participate in the Crewing Duty Phone rotation.

Operational excellence will underpin your work—maintaining accurate candidate data, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations, and collaborating across HR, Payroll, Training, and Vessel Operations teams. You’ll also contribute to shaping the future of our talent strategy through innovative ideas and quality-driven initiatives.

Who you are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry and enjoy building trusted relationships, and you recognize the game‑changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, HR, or related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in offshore recruitment.
  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Knowledge of maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, NORMAM).
  • Proven previous experience conducting recruitment processes for maritime positions.
  • Skilled in recruitment platforms and advanced Excel.
  • Strategic mindset, strong networking skills, and ability to work independently.
  • Passion for the maritime industry and commitment to diversity and inclusion.
  • Strong decision‑making, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in lean organisations and proactive process improvement.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast‑paced environments.
How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 30 November 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.
Your profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Our client’s Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft’s Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CE & Power Platform Senior Technical Architect is a core team member of our client’s customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The STA will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CE & Power Platform solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements
  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline;
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM Certifications (2016, D365) AND/OR Power Platform Certifications are desirable;
  • Strong technical & functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM and/or Power Platform technology stack covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors;
  • Minimum 12+ years of proven experience in IT which includes end to end implementation experience in either of Dynamics CRM / Power Platform solutions;
  • Strong and proven experience in developing solutions that involve Power Platform (including Power Apps like Canvas, Model driven etc., Power Automate, Power BI etc.);
  • Strong understanding of all areas within Customer Engagement including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Field Services, and Project Service;
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions etc.;
  • Good understand of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons;
  • Proven track record of successful maintenance or end to end implementation of a number of solutions for medium/ large customers, preferably across a number of business verticals (e.g. healthcare, finance, insurance etc.);
  • Proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients’ needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution following effective design approach;
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery;
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and DevOps methodologies;
  • Adept at business requirement analysis, solution design, development, system verification and deployment strategies;
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation;
  • Experience in creation of demos, supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage;
  • Business process mapping, Fit Gap analysis, work package estimation, work breakdown structure, modelling and documentation knowledge;
  • Excellent understanding of Dynamics CRM DB Schema and Business Data Model including the customisation and development of Business Data Models for different solutions;
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, development management, release management, data migrations, cut-over planning and hypercare support;
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps & CI/CD is a plus;
  • Knowledge and understanding of .NET framework including extensive experience writing ASP.NET and C# code (not just limited to plugins/custom workflows) is a plus;
Responsibilities

The CE Senior Technical Architect will work with the Consulting Services department to implement various modules of D365 CE (including Power Platform) working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.

  • Organise, execute, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders, business analysts and consulting team;
  • Interface effectively with other members of the consulting team to arrive at best in class solution, and provide a sustainable and scalable solution architecture and application to meet client’s requirements;
  • Deliver high quality business and software solutions & services to clients ensuring the implementation of best practices based on Microsoft Dynamics standards and supported configuration/ customizations;
  • Ensure completeness in meeting business requirements and take accountability for project deliverables including and not limited to project documentation, solution design, performance, reliability, testing features etc;
  • Deliver all consultancy and configuration work according to our project methodology, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully according to the SLA: on time and on budget;
  • Maximize usage of OOB features and provide technical design or develop/customize solution approach for identified gaps;
  • Contribute to activities as required including technical presales, building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations. Proactively skilling up on new versions and technology stack to be future ready;
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates;
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour;
  • Be a trusted advisor for our clients and help to provide solutions which can be upgrade ready;
  • Proactively identify business/ project/ technical/ support risks and provide suggestions to mitigate or communicate as necessary;
  • Proactively communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally;
  • Support practice development activities such as defining, solutioning and configuring industry specific solutions;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice;
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings;
  • Drive for process improvement, feature reusability and other initiatives to maximize efficiency in delivery;
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team or supervisors;
  • Provide guidance and mentorship (technical/professional) to groom other team members;
  • Represent our client’s Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times;
  • A portion of the role also requires supporting and doing people management, people development & career progression support, performance assessment and management;
  • The Employee is required to follow our client’s Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times;
Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That’s why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it’s great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you’ll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, our clients, and our communities.

This sets out all the different ways you’ll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

A Diffucap oferece um ambiente de trabalho ético, moderno e colaborativo para profissionais que transformam dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights, com estrutura híbrida e foco em resultados sustentáveis.

A cultura organizacional valoriza o aprendizado, o reconhecimento e o cumprimento das normas éticas da indústria farmacêutica.

O clima é acolhedor, incentivando a comunicação e o desenvolvimento pessoal.

Esse conjunto promove engajamento e alta performance profissional.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Objetivo do Cargo

Ser o líder da área que transforma dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights , direcionando decisões estratégicas e táticas para crescimento da Diffucap. Atua como ponte entre inteligência de mercado, vendas e marketing, garantindo que os relatórios suportem o planejamento (incluindo LE trimestral), execução comercial e monitoramento de KPIs de produtividade, demanda e vendas.

Inteligência de Mercado & Prescrição

Desenvolver e manter modelos de mercado, prescrição (RX) e demanda para todas as classes terapêuticas da Diffucap.

Monitorar concorrentes, detectar tendências de mercado (entrada de genéricos, mudança de canais, novas tecnologias administrativas) e transformar em recomendações estratégicas. Exemplos: o desempenho de Deocil (via sublingual), diferenciação via canal digital, etc.

Fornecer relatórios executivos regulares para a liderança (VP Comercial, BD, Marketing) com visão de cenário, oportunidades de expansão e alertas de risco.

Colaborar com a área de Business Development para suportar análise de mercado, atratividade de classes, potencial de prescrição e competitividade.

Produtividade Comercial & Administração de Vendas

Criar e gerir o sistema de segmentação de médicos (quadrante A, B, C, D) baseado em critérios de potencial de prescrição, margem de contribuição e uso crônico — conforme a priorização definida pela liderança comercial.

Definir e monitorar KPIs de produtividade (visitas, repescagem, lançamento, share de voz, share de prescrição), implementando dashboards para vendas, marketing e treinamento.

Revisar e aprimorar os relatórios existentes (vendas e RX) para torná-los simples, intuitivos e com governança para diferentes perfis de usuário.

Garantir a governança dos 3 períodos de LE (Last Expectation) trimestrais: consolidar dados de vendas, despesas, forecast e alinhamento para reporte aos acionistas.

Suporte Estratégico & Processos

Oferecer à liderança, nas reuniões de planejamento anual (ex: plano 2026) e trimestral, o input analítico para tomada de decisão, sem necessariamente definir o “o que cada área deve fazer”, mas esclarecendo “o que o cenário exige”.

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Marketing, Marketing Digital, Treinamento, BD e Vendas para traduzir insights em ações — por exemplo, canais digitais complementares, influência, governança de influenciadores.

Estabelecer e manter processos de governança de dados, acesso, qualidade, periodicidade de reporte e visibilidade para todas as áreas relevantes.

Formação Acadêmica

Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Farmacêutica ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação ou MBA será diferencial.

Experiência Desejada

Desejável experiência mínima de 5 anos em farmacêutica ou saúde, atuando em Inteligência de Mercado, Estratégia Comercial ou Analytics.

Competências Técnicas

Habilidade analítica avançada: Excel, Power BI/Tableau, modelagem de cenários, previsão de mercado.

Forte comunicação e influência — capacidade de apresentar insights estratégicos para alta liderança e converter em planos de ação.

Mentalidade estratégica, colaborativa e orientada para resultados — capaz de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico, com ambiguidade e múltiplos stakeholders.

Domínio de inglês (escrita e fala) será diferencial.

Visão de mercado e competitiva (capacidade de identificar oportunidades e riscos).

Transformação de dados brutos em recomendações claras e aplicáveis.

Governança de métricas, qualidade de dados e sistemas de inteligência.

Habilidade em estruturar relatórios e dashboards para diferentes níveis (Executivo, Operacional).

Influência cross-funcional — marketing, vendas, BD, treinamento, TI.

Proatividade e adaptabilidade — ambiência de rebranding e definição de posicionamento da empresa.

Employment Modality (Brazil - EOR): This remote role will be classified as a long-term Employment Relationship (Relação de Emprego) under the Brazilian Consolidated Labor Laws (CLT). The contract will be managed through a local Employer of Record (EOR) to ensure full compliance with all Brazilian labor laws, including benefits, mandatory contributions, and tenure.

About The Job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers the white-label travel platforms for some of the world’s largest financial institutions and airlines. As our strategic partner portfolio expands, so too does the need for sophisticated technical expertise and dedicated relationship management. We are seeking a high-impact Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be a technical liaison for multiple strategic partners. This critical role acts as the connective architect, seamlessly integrating Product, Engineering, Supply, and Customer Experience teams to ensure every partner receives clear, consistent, and exceptionally reliable support for technical inquiries and strategic growth initiatives. This is a hands‑on, results-oriented position. You will use your diagnostic skills and analytical abilities to validate incoming issues, structure comprehensive problem reports, and coordinate effectively with engineering. Your main goal is to ensure that all technical escalations are complete, actionable, and correctly prioritized. You will also play a key part in defining and optimizing our global intake, triage, communication, and escalation frameworks, helping partners get timely resolutions while keeping internal teams focused and efficient. In short, this role requires a blend of investigative curiosity, clear communication, strong organizational skills, and a process‑improvement mindset, applied across a dynamic portfolio of partners and parallel technical workstreams.

Partner Engagement & Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for multiple B2B partners, each with unique needs, priorities, and communication channels.
  • Translate partner inquiries into structured, actionable requests with complete context.
  • Provide clear updates, timelines, and expectations, ensuring partners feel supported and aligned.
Technical Triage & Analysis
  • Assess and validate reported issues before escalating to engineering, including reproduction steps, logs, context, severity assessment, and relevant data insights.
  • Investigate technical or data-centric questions using internal tools, dashboards, and SQL; identify whether issues stem from configuration, supply content, product behavior, data quality, or true system defects.
  • Manage and prioritize requests across multiple partners simultaneously, balancing urgency, impact, and engineering bandwidth.
Process & Program Development
  • Improve intake workflows, templates, and triage mechanisms to create consistency across partners.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, supply, and Customer Experience teams to refine escalation paths, service expectations, and communication standards.
  • Contribute to playbooks, documentation, and partner-facing resources to strengthen transparency and scale operational excellence.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
  • Coordinate with a wide and diverse set of stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, supply specialists, Customer Experience teams, and external partner teams.
  • Maintain clear follow-through, alignment, and ownership across parallel workstreams.
  • Advocate for partner needs while helping internal teams maintain focus and momentum.
An ideal candidate has
  • An excellent communicator who can build trust with partners and internal teams through clarity, consistency, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable operating across several partners at once, with strong prioritization, context-switching, and organizational skills.
  • Adept at turning ambiguity into clarity and designing repeatable processes that scale.
  • Technically fluent, with experience interpreting logs, analyzing data, exploring APIs, and using monitoring tools to support issue investigation and triage.
  • Experienced in roles such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Product Specialist, or a similar hybrid technical-customer role.
  • Strong judgment in evaluating issue severity, partner impact, and operational urgency.
Nice to Haves
  • Intermediate or advanced SQL skills; experience working with data analysis, BI tools, or large datasets (BigQuery experience is a plus).
  • Familiarity with API debugging, distributed systems, or SaaS platform operations.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ticketing and triage systems (Zendesk, Jira Service Desk, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Background improving cross-functional workflows or partner-facing operations at scale.
Perks and benefits of working with us
  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.
More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Key Statistics
  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6× more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel eCommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen‑Z and Millennials.

title: Associate Director, Design
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring an Associate Director, Design - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in both managing creative talent and driving high-quality design execution across various platforms. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

You will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of leadership and creativity in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment, where you’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-2 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Experience in e‑commerce or hospitality website design, familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.

Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region

The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them

  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people

  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree

  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
  • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
  • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
  • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
  • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. RINA is currently recruiting for a HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

Mission

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. The role supports the application of the Corporate and Company policies, developing and implementing security policies, guidelines, procedures and protocols, for the security of Company assets, projects and business travels. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Compliance Monitoring:
- Ensure that the organization complies with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations.
- Monitor and track changes in regulations and update relevant stakeholders.
Risk Assessment:
- Assist in conducting risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the workplace.
- Collaborate with other departments to analyze and mitigate risks.
Training and Education:
- Support the development and delivery of HSE training programs for employees.
- Help create educational materials to promote awareness of health and safety issues.
Incident Investigation:
- Participate in investigations of accidents, incidents, or near-misses to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.
- Assist in the documentation of incidents and the implementation of corrective actions.
Data Analysis:
- Collect and analyze HSE data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
- Prepare reports on HSE performance and make recommendations based on the analysis.
Emergency Response Planning:
- Contribute to the development and testing of emergency response plans.
- Assist in organizing drills and training exercises for emergency situations.
Inspections and Audits:
- Support regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with HSE policies and procedures.
- Document findings and work with relevant teams to address any deficiencies.
Communication:
- Assist in the communication of HSE policies and procedures to employees.
- Participate in HSE meetings and collaborate with other departments to promote a culture of safety.
Documentation and Record Keeping:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to HSE activities.
- Assist in preparing documentation for regulatory agencies and internal audits.
Continuous Improvement:
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures.
- Stay informed about industry best practices and incorporate relevant updates into the HSE program.

Qualifications
  • Technical degree in occupational safety is mandatory, along with registration with the Ministry of Labor and Employment. Bachelor's degree is a plus.

  • Ability to analyze data and identify trends related to health, safety, and environmental performance.
  • Experience in conducting risk assessments , safety audits, and ensuring compliance with local and international standards.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS

Triunfo Logística

Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI’s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos físicos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

title: Field Service Electrical Engineer
description:
Would you like to work in the field supporting our customers? Are you a Field Service Electrical Engineer looking for an interesting opportunity? Do you enjoy working independently with a high level of accountability?

We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team ensures the integrity of data and provides valuable financial insight to the business.

Partner with the best

As a Field Service Electrical Engineer, you will play a vital role in creating products that fulfil both business and technical needs of our customers. You'll oversee the installation/commissioning/startup and various level maintenance/trouble‑shooting of our products. You'll use your knowledge and skills to deliver innovative solutions for our customers.

As a Field Service Electrical Engineer , you will be responsible for:

  • Commission HV Generators, Motors, Synchronous condensers, Power management systems (PMS), Electrical protection systems, Excitation Controllers (AVRs), and Synchronising equipment.
  • Ideally have knowledge of networking systems. Such as, Modbus, Ethernet, 61850, Fibre.
  • Perform role applying company health and safety procedures applicable to the job site. Typical examples are HV safety, lock out tag out, permit to work systems and risk and method statements.
  • Conduct upgrades to AVRS, PMS systems, Synchronisers, Protection relays and other control elements.
  • Carry out electrical testing on high and low voltage equipment and machine windings in the field. Examples may include Polarisation Index, Insulation resistance, and Ductor tests.
  • Must be prepared to practice some degree of project management at site.
  • Deliver training on Brush Power Gen products to clients and field service colleagues.
  • Interpret technical drawings, specifications and technical requirements. Attend technical meetings on site and at customers’ premises.
  • Prepare method statements and risk assessments in relation to client sites where needed.
  • Assist mechanical service engineer(s) on assignments, which will not necessarily involve electrical related activities.
  • The job description is not to be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive and you may be required to undertake various duties as may reasonably be required of you by the Company.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Ideally hold a graduate degree or bachelors degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering.
  • Alternatively completed arecognized craft apprenticeship in electrical engineering and be able to demonstrate significant experience gained working in the field. Must hold a technical qualification in an electrical or electronic discipline.
  • Experience of working on competitors equipment would be advantageous.
  • High level knowledge of electrical power generation and distribution systems.
  • Self reliant, resourceful and a problem solver with well developed commercial awareness
  • An effective communicator, fluent in both spoken and written English and Portuguese.
  • Able to undertake extensive overseas and offshore working.
  • Experienced in representing the Company at customers’ sites and operating remotely on own initiative whilst observing the requirements set down in the Company’s Code of Conduct for Service/Commissioning Engineers.
  • Able to work with Company’s rules and guidance notes on health and safety, including operation of safe systems of work in relation to high voltage and medium voltage electrical systems and work in a heavy industrial environment.
  • This is a challenging and important role requiring a high degree of technical competence with a corresponding level of self‑sufficiency and resourcefulness, as global time differences often mean that factory support is not immediately available. The nature of the work calls for strength of character and physical fitness. Differing assignments may require working alone or as a member of a team.
  • Clear understanding of cultural differences and has the diplomacy to cope with all aspects of the role.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

We invest in the health and well‑being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

title: Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang
description:
Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world‑class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.

As an engineering manager you need both technical and management skills to lead your team. You will represent the team in direct partner engagement, ensuring stability and functionality that our cloud users expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU‑aided AI for servers, VMs, and containers.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring they grow as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. You will challenge and grow your team members with technical leadership and a solid background in software development. You will influence culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team builds. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Responsibilities
  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
Qualifications
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
Benefits
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Canonical by 2x.

Client Services Lead

Eles supervisionam o desempenho e o alinhamento dos serviços de TI, garantem a conformidade com os padrões e SLAs, gerenciam os relacionamentos com os stakeholders e promovem uma cultura de melhoria contínua de serviços usando dados e análises.

  • Fazer parceria com a Equipe de Infraestrutura para garantir o melhor em Gerenciamento de Rede, Gerenciamento de Servidores, Operações de Armazenamento e Data Center, Gerenciamento de Hardware e Software, Monitoramento de Sistemas e Otimização de Desempenho, Gerenciamento de Configuração, Segurança e Continuidade de Negócios, Planejamento de Recuperação de Desastres.

Job description

Nossa história resume bem o que somos: uma combinação entre nosso potencial e a dedicação de quem acredita que limites existem para serem superados.

Sabemos que para ganhar o jogo precisamos dos melhores talentos e estamos aqui para jogar a longo prazo. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que queiram evoluir continuamente e se desafiar a construir algo relevante para nossos clientes.

Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Main responsibilities

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: Responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.
Requirements and skills

Você deve ter os seguintes requisitos:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas;
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI;
  • Conhecimento com sistemas de CFTV;
  • Vivência com SAP.

description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

Essa pessoa será responsável por elevar o nível técnico e estrutural da área de SRE, conectando confiabilidade, automação e eficiência de custos aos objetivos de negócio.

O papel exige uma liderança com sólida bagagem técnica, capaz de alinhar estratégia, direcionar arquitetura e fortalecer a cultura de engenharia de excelência. É uma oportunidade de criar frameworks e padrões de excelência em confiabilidade, abstrair a infraestrutura para os times de produto e impulsionar a automação e a eficiência operacional em larga escala.

Buscamos alguém com olhar sistêmico, que entenda profundamente o ciclo de confiabilidade — da infraestrutura à experiência do desenvolvedor — e que consiga transitar entre a visão estratégica e a execução técnica, fomentando colaboração e impacto direto no negócio.

  • Liderar os squads de Platform, Core e FinOps, garantindo alinhamento entre confiabilidade, automação e eficiência de custos.

  • Impulsionar a adoção de boas práticas em FinOps, otimizar custos de cloud e promover sustentabilidade de infraestrutura.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de ownership, colaboração e excelência técnica, com decisões baseadas em dados e impacto.

  • Conhecimento profundo em observabilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade de sistemas distribuídos.
